categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Beilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: chemical pharmaceuticals and traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). The chemical pharmaceuticals segment focuses on contrast agents (MRI and CT contrast agents), anti-diabetic drugs, and raw materials. The TCM segment includes central nervous system drugs, heat-clearing and detoxifying medicines, cold remedies, kidney tonics, digestive aids, blood circulation and pain relief products, and liver and gallbladder medicines. The company also engages in research, development, production, and sales of these pharmaceutical products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including chemical synthesis for contrast agents and raw materials, and traditional preparation methods for Chinese patent medicines. It has obtained EU GMP and Brazil ANVISA GMP certifications, indicating compliance with international quality standards. The company also invests heavily in R&D, focusing on drug consistency evaluations, new drug registrations, and development of proprietary formulations such as the exclusive pure Chinese medicine 'Jiuwei Zhenxin Granules'.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include hospitals, healthcare institutions, and pharmaceutical distributors within China and overseas markets in South America, Africa, and Asia (excluding the US). The company serves patients requiring diagnostic imaging contrast agents, diabetes treatment, and TCM for central nervous system and other conditions. Its products are included in national and regional centralized procurement programs, and it targets both domestic and international healthcare markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Beijing, Cangzhou, Anhui, Hebei, Zhejiang, and Hong Kong. It has expanded its overseas market presence to South America, Africa, and Asia, with ongoing registration efforts in Hong Kong, Thailand, Korea, India, and the European Union. The company’s sales are distributed across multiple Chinese regions including East China, South China, Central China, North China, Northeast, Southwest, and Northwest, with significant growth in southern and central regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beilu Pharma operates both upstream and midstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain. It produces raw materials (active pharmaceutical ingredients) for contrast agents and other drugs, manufactures finished pharmaceutical formulations, and conducts R&D. The company controls production of key raw materials such as iodine-based and gadolinium-based contrast agent intermediates and APIs, positioning itself as an integrated pharmaceutical manufacturer from raw materials to finished products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on a dual-driven model of chemical pharmaceuticals and traditional Chinese medicine. R&D priorities include expanding contrast agent product lines, developing new anti-diabetic and central nervous system drugs, and innovating TCM products like Jiuwei Zhenxin Granules. It emphasizes efficiency improvements in R&D, international registration of products, and leveraging centralized procurement policies. The company also pursues acquisitions to enrich its TCM portfolio and invests in production capacity expansion and international GMP certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products including contrast agents, anti-diabetic drugs, TCM formulations, and raw materials. The company also earns income from technology service fees related to pharmaceutical research. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally. Participation in national and regional centralized procurement programs contributes to stable revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Beilu Pharma is positioned as a leading Chinese pharmaceutical manufacturer with a strong presence in contrast agents and TCM markets. It competes with other domestic and international pharmaceutical companies in chemical generics and traditional medicine sectors. The company leverages exclusive products, extensive product lines, and international certifications to enhance competitiveness. Its acquisition of Tianyuan Pharmaceutical strengthens its position in the TCM market, aiming to build a second growth curve.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 983.55 million, a 10.42% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 13.65 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.98 billion, with steady growth in revenue and cash flow from operations. Despite challenges from procurement price pressures, the company’s diversified product portfolio and overseas expansion support a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Beilu Pharma emphasizes its dual-driven business model combining chemical pharmaceuticals and traditional Chinese medicine to provide diversified healthcare solutions. Its unique value lies in exclusive proprietary TCM products like Jiuwei Zhenxin Granules, recognized as the leading anti-anxiety Chinese medicine brand, and a comprehensive contrast agent portfolio with multiple gadolinium-based MRI agents. The company’s international GMP certifications and expanding overseas registrations differentiate it in quality and global reach. Integration of raw material production with finished formulations enhances supply chain control and cost competitiveness.
